annotations.title: Get earlier versions of a record

description: List what a software record, request or proposal said before each edit. USE WHEN a record's `version` is above 1 and the user asks what changed, or you need the text a verdict, proposal or earlier answer was based on. NEEDS entity_type and entity_id. NO side effects; public. Returns current_version and earlier_versions (newest first) with their content, when each was published and replaced, and the author's change note. Only the current record is in force. Recovery: NOT_FOUND means the record does not exist or is no longer public.

entity_id.description: ID of the record: sw_... (or slug), req_... or sol_....

entity_type.description: Kind of record whose history to list: software, request or solution (a proposal).

name: get_history
title: Get earlier versions of a record
